svg.title: One Microsoft sign-in for the lrh-* connectors
svg.desc: The Outlook, Teams and SharePoint connectors call the lrh-m365-auth library on this computer. It keeps one encrypted MSAL token cache with a profile per Microsoft client and resource, for one active account. Microsoft Entra ID handles the password and verification on Microsoft's own sign-in page; the library asks only for profiles that are not approved yet.
svg.text: One Microsoft sign-in for every connector
lrh-m365-auth keeps one encrypted token cache that the Outlook, Teams and SharePoint connectors share.

g.text: A library on your computer · no daemon
A profile per client and resource
Asks only for what is missing

svg.text: The library never sees a password and makes no Outlook, Teams or SharePoint requests; each connector calls its own services.
